editorialProfile.tone: curious, grounded nature and conservation reporting
editorialProfile.defaultCustomRequest: Prepare a balanced, source-linked rolling live feed about wildlife, ecology, oceans, biodiversity, climate and conservation. Preserve the original reporting context. Use documentary photographs only when their exact source page, creator, licence and contextual caption have been independently verified by the Nature Collector. Never invent photography, misidentify a species, or present a contextual photograph as the image from a research paper or source article. A report without an approved photograph remains eligible as a text report. Prioritize the newest eligible reporting while retaining useful topic variety.

imagePolicy.optimization: Wikimedia Commons thumbnail up to 1600px; preserve attribution and ShareAlike notice
